messages:
mohit: FYI — Wed 2026-04-01 01:30 UTC we're doing a soft-swap BMC watchdog reload across az3. Aim: clear a firmware timer leak that causes rare kernel hangs. We'll do staggered cohorts of 2 racks every ~40m, with health checks and KV-cache priming. Cohorts chosen to keep any single host-pool >= 85% capacity.

elaine: what's the impact on running jobs? will pods get evicted?

mohit: We'll cordon + drain nodes gracefully. Evictions targeted to best-effort workloads only; enterprise/critical tenants will be marked "no-evict" and routed to reserved backfill if required. Per-node eviction window ~3m; per-rack work ~18m including checks.

ana (scheduler): Canary plan: shadow traffic for one small tenant for 25m after the first cohort. Abort conditions: p95 > 200ms OR error-rate > 2x baseline. Also will disable auto-fallback for flagged enterprise tenants during the window.

sam: If a BMC reload leaves nodes in an unknown state, what's the remediation?

sre-oncall: Remediation path: attempt BMC watchdog clear / reboot; if node unreachable after 12m mark for manual OOB (ILO/BMC cable) and escalate to on-site tech. We'll station an on-site tech for first two cohorts. Add a job to detect & clear orphaned KV entries after reboot: `scripts/kv-purge-orphans --pool az3-cohort --dry-run` then apply.

mira: Can we bump prefix_cache.duration to 900s for affected pools to avoid token regen storms?

todd: Cost note — reserved backfill for critical tenants estimated ~$1.9k for window + ~3% scheduler churn. If needed, shift noncritical spot workloads pre-window.

mohit: Runbook (paste):

```
# cohort ops
# cordon + drain with graceful termination
kubectl cordon $NODE
kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=180
# post-reboot checks
scripts/check-host-health --node $NODE || flag_for_oob
scripts/kv-prime --pool $POOL --target-hitrate 0.75 --timeout 20m
# rollback
kubectl uncordon $NODE
```

ops-bot: maintenance created: id=maint-20260401-az3-bmc-softswap ; start=2026-04-01T01:30:00Z ; est-duration=5h30m ; owners=[mohit,ana]

ana (scheduler): I'll push a transient profile: batch.max_wait_ms=12, prefix_cache.ttl=900, auto-revert after 40m. Canary job scheduled per rack.

ops-bot: alarms created: dd/az3-p95-latency, dd/az3-error-rate ; notify=#eng-oncall,#eng-sre

sam: Network note — avoid simultaneous NIC firmware ioctl across cohorts; keep egress throttle at 80% during warmup.

elaine: Comms: draft customer notice with enterprise-impact flags. Internal banner 1h prior; I'll own drafts and the pinned slack message.

sre-oncall: Acceptance criteria to proceed: KV hitrate >= 72% AND token tail latency within 12% of baseline for 20m after warmup. If not met, pause and run `scripts/kv-reconcile`.

mohit: Copy. Tagging ops-oncall and updating the maintenance ticket with thresholds. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
